normalization.body: TypeScript printer removeComments; exclude top-level import declarations; Prettier fixed formatting. No transpilation or renaming of declarations, function bodies, literals, identifiers, JSX, or import bindings.
normalization.imports: Resolve only explicit @/*->./src/* mappings proven from both app tsconfigs and ordinary relative POSIX path normalization. Retain imported/local/typeOnly bindings. Compare records ignoring order; this does not prove runtime module resolution or side-effect ordering equivalence.

limitations: Only one fixed candidate and 20 upstream paths inspected; no exhaustive upstream/import history search.
Ignoring import order supports a syntax mapping only and is not a runtime-equivalence claim when modules have side effects.
Differences in remaining modules stay unresolved; this candidate being later than first tracking commit is explicit.
